description:
Listing code 842701.

Pet-friendly and fully furnished, this two-bedroom apartment at Live Oasis Belgrave Street offers high-quality accommodation for students in Leeds city centre. It’s perfect for living with friends or if you are looking for extra living space.

Each bedroom includes a large bed with underbed storage, bedside table, spacious wardrobe and study area with a desk and chair - ideal for working from home or studying in peace.

The modern bathroom has premium finishes, integrated storage, a rainfall shower, heated towel rail and full tiling throughout.

The open plan kitchen is fitted with high-spec appliances including an oven and hob, washer-dryer, integrated fridge/freezer, and a microwave. There is a dining table and chairs within the apartment - perfect for dining with friends. The living area offers comfort and convenience, with a two-seater sofa, coffee table, shelving and a smart TV.

Highlights of Live Oasis Wade Lane benefits:
- All bills included
- Student apartments
- Pet friendly accommodation
- Fully furnished apartments
- Access to grab n go breakfast
- Access to nearby gym
- Access to nearby resident lounges
- Concierge service
- CCTV and fob entry
- Free resident events
